description:
• About our brand and products: 

AliDrop.ae is a modern e-commerce platform based in the UAE that specializes in direct dropshipping of quality products from AliExpress, Shopify, Amazon, Noon and other product suppliers to customers around the world, especially in the Gulf region.

We offer thousands of popular products - from fashion and electronics to beauty and home essentials - all carefully selected for quality, price and fast shipping options.

Our mission is to bring the power of global e-commerce to the UAE market and make international shopping fast, reliable and affordable.


• What makes us different:

Official Model Inspired by Professional Partners: We work with top suppliers from stores like AliExpress and Amazon to ensure authenticity and consistent quality.

UAE-based Service and Support: Reasonable pricing, fast delivery options, and customer service to most countries around the world.

Luxury meets simplicity: A sleek, minimalist brand experience designed for trust and convenience.

Automated Dropshipping System: Seamless integration between product suppliers and buyers and dropshippers


• How affiliates can earn:

Earn up to 5% commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link, with no financial investment required.

Access your personal dashboard to track your clicks, sales, and commissions in real time.

Receive regular, no-delay monthly payments directly via PayPal or bank transfer and various other methods (in UAE Dirhams or US Dollars).

Premium users benefit from exclusive rewards and promotional opportunities.


• How to promote :

  • Share your unique referral links on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and blogs.

  • Create short review videos, product unboxings, or tutorials featuring our best sellers.

  • Use custom banners and promo codes (we’ll provide them) for your audience.

  • Collaborate in seasonal campaigns — we’ll invite top affiliates to participate in UAE-exclusive sales events.


• Other information:

Membership in this program is completely free and open to influencers, bloggers, and digital marketers worldwide.

We offer real-time analytics, automated tracking, and fraud protection.

Customer orders are shipped directly from verified AliExpress and Amazon suppliers, ensuring reliability.
